_comment: Texts of the app without a counterpart in the I18nResources bundles of the server. Everything else comes from generated.en.json (bin/pfDev.sh gen).
app.login.info: The login opens in the browser: there you enter your password and your second factor as usual.
app.logout.question: Log out the app? It can only be used again after a new login.
app.businessCard.createOnDesktop: Create and edit business cards in the web version
app.offline: No connection to the server: the cards as last loaded.
app.proxy.refused: The server can't be reached through its login gateway (SSO proxy). Please log in again; if that doesn't help, the gateway has to let the app through.
app.server.httpsRequired: The server must be reachable via https.
app.server.invalid: This is no valid server address.
app.server.label: Server
app.session.expired: The app has been logged out (in the web, by a password change or after a longer time without usage). Please log in again.
app.web.failed: The pages of ProjectForge couldn't be opened.
app.settings.openInApp.info: These menu entries of the web pages switch to the tab of the app. Switched off, the web version stays, e.g. if the app's version doesn't work with the server.
app.log.title: Log
app.log.settingsInfo: What the app did (login, requests, pages), e.g. for a support request.
app.log.info: Kept only in memory and for at most one day. Passwords, tokens and cookie values are never written.
app.address.offline: No connection to the server: the addresses as of the last sync.
app.address.noFavorites: No favorites. Favorites are marked in the web pages.
app.timesheet.offline: No connection to the server: the time sheets as of the last update.
app.timesheet.acceptancePending: Waiting for the approval of the project management
app.timesheet.panel.hint: Tap a time sheet or choose “Book”.
app.timesheet.task.hint: Type part of the name or the path to search.
app.timesheet.task.onlyBookable: Only structure elements that may be booked on.
app.timesheet.template.delete.question: Delete the template “{0}”?
app.timesheet.timer.started: The timer is running. Stopping books it rounded to 5 minutes.
app.timesheet.timer.sinceNoTask: since {0} · choose the structure element when stopping
